title: Four-way intersection signal controller (two directions)
nl_spec: Control a two-direction (North-South and East-West) traffic intersection with a six-phase cycle: 0 = NS green / EW red, 1 = NS yellow / EW red, 2 = all-red clearance, 3 = EW green / NS red, 4 = EW yellow / NS red, 5 = all-red clearance, then repeat. Green lasts PT_GREEN = 2 ticks, yellow PT_YELLOW = 1 tick, all-red PT_ALLRED = 1 tick. Each direction has green/yellow/red outputs. Use an internal INT State (0..5) and three TON timers (green, yellow, all-red) gated by the relevant states. SAFETY-CRITICAL: the two directions must never both show a movement aspect (green or yellow) at the same time; when one direction may move, the cross direction must be red. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named intersection with outputs NS_G, NS_Y, NS_R, EW_G, EW_Y, EW_R (no inputs; it free-runs).

safety_properties.nl: Both directions never show green at the same time.
Conflicting movements never occur: the two directions never both show a movement aspect (green or yellow).
When NS may move (green or yellow), EW is red.
When EW may move (green or yellow), NS is red.

scenarios.description: NS green -> NS yellow -> all-red -> EW green

notes: Six-phase free-running cycle with all-red clearance phases. Three timers gated by state sets (green: 0|3, yellow: 1|4, all-red: 2|5). The cross-conflict invariant P2 is the safety-critical property.
